question: Older tutorials use Soroban RPC, the soroban CLI, and the github.com/stellar/go monorepo. What is each called now?

golden.answer: Soroban RPC is now Stellar RPC (repository stellar/stellar-rpc), rebranded with Protocol 22. The Soroban CLI is now the Stellar CLI (stellar/stellar-cli, command `stellar`). The stellar/go monorepo is archived; since October 2025 the Go SDK lives at github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk. As of 2026-11-14 the old soroban-rpc and soroban-cli repository URLs redirect to the new names.
keyFacts: Soroban RPC was renamed Stellar RPC.
The Soroban CLI was renamed the Stellar CLI.
The Go SDK moved from the stellar/go monorepo to stellar/go-stellar-sdk.
avoid: Do NOT describe Soroban RPC and Stellar RPC as two separate current products.
golden.notes: Accept later repository names if a dated source shows a further move.

sources.quote: With the rollout of Protocol 22, it has been rebranded to Stellar RPC.
Stellar CLI (Previously Soroban CLI) ... Soroban CLI has been renamed to Stellar CLI.
As of October 2025, it has been refactored to focus exclusively on developer-facing SDK packages.
archived: true; description: Archived public monorepo of go code
